text: auditor_jones: Hi team — during our SOC 2 walkthrough the auditor asked for an end-to-end chain-of-custody for backups and any keys used. Specifically they want: 1) current KMS key inventory (aliases + creation dates + owner) 2) Access logs showing Decrypt/GenerateDataKey/API usage for the last 12 months (or retention window we have) 3) RBAC change tickets/approvals for key policy or IAM role changes tied to those keys 4) any emergency/just-in-time access records and the associated approval artifacts. Can we compile this and provide a presigned evidence bundle? Prefer S3 link with retention set for auditor access.
text_extra: sara: Ack — copying required data sources: AWS KMS, CloudTrail (management & data events), our SIEM (sumo/elk), and the ticketing system. I can grab key inventory + key policy change history. Will need help pulling cross-account decrypt events (mike?) :mag:
text_more: mike: I can run the CloudTrail / Athena export for Decrypt and GenerateDataKey operations. Our current CloudTrail retention is 400 days in the S3 bucket and indexed in the SIEM for 365 days. For cross-account usage we have the role assumption logs in `cloudtrail_events` index. Example query I’ll use in Athena / CloudTrail:
query_snippet:
```sql
  SELECT eventTime, userIdentity.arn, eventName, requestParameters.keyId, sourceIPAddress
  FROM cloudtrail_table
  WHERE eventName IN ('Decrypt','GenerateDataKey')
    AND eventTime BETWEEN from_iso8601_timestamp('2025-03-01T00:00:00Z') AND from_iso8601_timestamp('2026-03-01T00:00:00Z')
  ORDER BY eventTime DESC
  LIMIT 10000;
  ```
text_followup: raj: For RBAC change approvals we should link the IAM PRs and the change advisory tickets. Our change log is in Jira under SEC-CHG with tags `kms-policy` or `iam-role`. I'll export attachments + approval comments. Note: emergency break-glass access is recorded in OpsVault with ticket refs — I’ll include tamper-evidence snapshots.
emily: I’ll package keys list from KMS console and include `aws kms describe-key` outputs and aliases with creation timestamps. Sample command:
kms_cmd:
```
  aws kms list-aliases --query 'Aliases[].{AliasName:AliasName,TargetKeyId:TargetKeyId}'
  aws kms describe-key --key-id 1234abcd-12ab-34cd-56ef-1234567890ab
  ```
deploy_bot: deploy-bot: Evidence bundle creator started. Generating temporary S3 bucket `redwood-audit-evidence-1768123456` and presigned link expiring in 14 days.
resolution_steps: sara: Plan -> mike runs CloudTrail export + SIEM forward, raj collects Jira approvals, emily exports KMS metadata and key policy diffs, I will assemble proof-of-chain (artifact manifest) and checksums, then upload to the evidence bucket. I will document mapping to SOC control IDs and include a short narrative for each artifact.
auditor_qna: auditor_jones: Two clarifying Qs: A) Are decrypt events for service accounts (internal inference runtime) audited with the same retention? B) For emergency access, please include who approved the emergency and the post-facto review outcome.
short_answers: mike: A) Yes, service account decrypts are logged via CloudTrail and show the assumed-role ARN. We’ll tag those entries when exporting. B) Raj will pull the emergency approval tickets; we have mandatory post-incident reviews recorded under SEC-POST.
evidence_links: deploy-bot: Evidence bundle uploaded -> https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-audit-evidence-1768123456/evidence_bundle_2026-03-15.zip (presigned, expires 2026-03-29). Included files: keys.csv, kms_describe_outputs/, cloudtrail_decrypt_events_2025-03-01_2026-03-01.json.gz, jira_approvals_export.csv, opsvault_emergency_snapshots.tar.gz, manifest_checksums.txt
final_notes: sara: Putting the final mapping doc in the bundle: `control_mapping_SOC2_v2.xlsx` that maps each artifact to the SOC 2 control and the internal runbook reference. Also linking incident INC-2026-042 which had a temporary key rotation — included timeline and minutes from the change call.
close: auditor_jones: Thanks — this looks good. I’ll verify the bundle and follow up if we need raw CloudTrail snippets for a few filtered IPs. Appreciate the quick turnaround :handshake:
post_thread: mike: noted — I’ll also drop the Athena query and a CSV export in #help for anyone who needs to replicate. Filed follow-up action: SEC-AUD-2026-07 to automate monthly evidence snapshot.
notes: (All timestamps above are aligned to thread root 1768123456. Artifacts referenced are real in our environment; presigned link placeholder will be rotated after auditor confirms download.)
